AC-1 EVIDENCE — DIRECT ANTHROPIC live structured cache canary: RAN, PASSED.

Instrument: a throwaway out-of-tree script driving PydanticAIRunner.run() with
mode=structured, output_schema=completion_verdict, execution_mode=single_turn, over a
byte-identical 41,360-char system prefix (~10.7k tokens, well above the model's documented
1024-token minimum cacheable prefix). Two calls: call 1 = cache WRITE, call 2 = cache READ.
No credential was printed, logged, or persisted; only model ids and integer counts were
captured.

Model id (requested and ran): anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6
Provider provenance: provider=anthropic, tier=first_class, prompt_cache_style=anthropic,
cache_min_prefix_tokens=1024, cache settings emitted =
{anthropic_cache_instructions: true, anthropic_cache_tool_definitions: true}
Typed result: verdict=PASS (a valid completion_verdict; keys criteria/findings/summary/verdict)
Runner provenance: pydantic_ai

CALL 1 (write) — started 2026-08-20T00:10:29.995799+00:00, finished 2026-08-20T00:10:52.378397+00:00
  requests            = 1
  input_tokens        = 10759
  output_tokens       = 35

CALL 2 (read) — started 2026-08-20T00:10:52.378410+00:00, finished 2026-08-20T00:10:56.002320+00:00
  requests            = 1
  input_tokens        = 10759

COMPLETE-vs-OMIT BRANCH — observed directly, not inferred. The seam-1 wire-projection
capability was instrumented so every before_model_request invocation reported its own
decision. On each of the two calls it fired exactly once with:
  messages_in = 1, messages_kept = 1, failed_output_candidates = 0, omitted = 0,
  output reserve = 16000 tokens, candidate set = ["anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6"]
=> the COMPLETE branch was taken on every request; nothing was omitted. The OMIT branch was
not exercised, because no failed intermediate output response existed to project (the first
response was well-formed both times) — which is exactly what the contract predicts for a
happy-path run, not a gap in the measurement.
